mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets ( user_id, name, breed, weight_kg, birth_date, notes ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{breed}, #{weightKg}, NULL, #{notes} )

INSERT INTO reservations ( reservation_code, user_id, pet_id, room_id, checkin_date, checkout_date, visit_time, guardian_name, guardian_phone, status, base_amount, extra_amount, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{reservationCode}, #{userId}, #{petId}, #{roomId}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{visitTime}, #{guardianName}, #{guardianPhone}, #{status}, #{baseAmount}, #{extraAmount}, #{totalAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reservation_code, r.user_id, r.pet_id, r.room_id, r.checkin_date, r.checkout_date, r.visit_time, r.guardian_name, r.guardian_phone, r.status, r.base_amount, r.extra_amount, r.total_amount, r.created_at, rm.name AS room_name, p.name AS pet_name FROM reservations r INNER JOIN rooms rm ON rm.id = r.room_id INNER JOIN pets p ON p.id = r.pet_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_code, r.user_id, r.pet_id, r.room_id, r.checkin_date, r.checkout_date, r.visit_time, r.guardian_name, r.guardian_phone, r.status, r.base_amount, r.extra_amount, r.total_amount, r.created_at, rm.name AS room_name, p.name AS pet_name FROM reservations r INNER JOIN rooms rm ON rm.id = r.room_id INNER JOIN pets p ON p.id = r.pet_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_code, r.user_id, r.pet_id, r.room_id, r.checkin_date, r.checkout_date, r.visit_time, r.guardian_name, r.guardian_phone, r.status, r.base_amount, r.extra_amount, r.total_amount, r.created_at, rm.name AS room_name, p.name AS pet_name FROM reservations r INNER JOIN rooms rm ON rm.id = r.room_id INNER JOIN pets p ON p.id = r.pet_id WHERE r.reservation_code = #{reservationCode}

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_code, r.user_id, r.pet_id, r.room_id, r.checkin_date, r.checkout_date, r.visit_time, r.guardian_name, r.guardian_phone, r.status, r.base_amount, r.extra_amount, r.total_amount, r.created_at, rm.name AS room_name, p.name AS pet_name FROM reservations r INNER JOIN rooms rm ON rm.id = r.room_id INNER JOIN pets p ON p.id = r.pet_id WHERE r.reservation_code = #{reservationCode} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reservation_code = #{reservationCode}

UPDATE reservations SET room_id = #{roomId}, pet_id = #{petId}, checkin_date = #{checkInDate}, checkout_date = #{checkOutDate}, visit_time = #{visitTime}, guardian_name = #{guardianName}, guardian_phone = #{guardianPhone}, base_amount = #{baseAmount}, extra_amount = #{extraAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reservation_code = #{reservationCode} AND user_id = #{userId}
